entities.summary: Dutch East India Company, a political institution in Taiwan during European Colonial Period (1624–1662). Led to the emergence of Spanish establish Fort San Domingo in northern Taiwan and Koxinga besieges and captures Fort Zeelandia — expelling the Dutch from Taiwan.
